subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should `channel-list` expose every conversation visible to the selected Slack read token, or only conversations allowed by OpenClaw's configured Slack channel policy?
rationale: The codebase defines authorization for reads targeting a known channel, but it does not define the disclosure boundary for agent-initiated workspace enumeration; that choice affects private-channel and DM metadata.

options.title: Filter through channel policy
options.body: Expose both actions but return only conversations authorized by the effective Slack group/channel policy, with private and DM discovery excluded unless explicitly allowed.

options.title: Return token-visible conversations
options.body: Expose every conversation returned by Slack for the selected read token behind the existing `channelInfo` action gate.

options.title: Ship channel-info only
options.body: Allow lookup of a supplied channel ID while deferring workspace enumeration until a separate discovery policy is designed.

recommendation.title: Filter through channel policy
recommendation.body: Expose both actions but return only conversations authorized by the effective Slack group/channel policy, with private and DM discovery excluded unless explicitly allowed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across Slack action discovery, runtime, tests, and documentation and is best positioned to resolve the disclosure contract.
